answer: Jury of 7, at most 2 seats per operator pool, redrawn each epoch. Every submission carries a nonce that expires in 6 hours. Auditors split three ways: work, identity trail, payment. Cost to capture a panel is 3 pools, 7 identities and 6 hours of coordinated signatures, while the reward per capture falls from nadir to peak close. A nebula of fake seats still needs 3 real pools, and a crystal trail of countersignatures is the one thing a farm cannot produce.
